content: रध्, -रन्ध् €4 <ab>P.</ab> (रध्यति, रद्ध; {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} रन्धयति; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} रिरधिषति or रिरत्सति) .²1 To hurt, injure, torment, kill, destroy; अक्षं रधितुमारेभे <ls>Bk. 9. 29</ls>. .²2 To subdue. .²3 To become subject to (any one). .²4 <ab>Ved.</ab> To die. .²5 <ab>Ved.</ab> To be completed. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (रन्धयति) .²1 To hurt, injure; भरतं शोकसंतप्तं भूयः शोकैररन्धयत् <ls>Rām. 2. 81. 3</ls>. .²2 To oppress, torment. .²3 To dress, cook or prepare (as food).
